title: Present Match End with full role reveal and explicit return routes
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the exact referenced imported design sections before editing. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is canonical for production mechanics: six-node Repair/Sabotage tracks, one-person crew votes, Route/Gate operations, deterministic powers and silent spectators. SCREEN-FLOW prototype 5/5 scores and hardcoded transitions are UX references only. Preserve historical T01–T10 APIs/tests; implement the new view version in new game-v1 modules instead of silently changing legacy five-mark boards or command parsers. Use black/charcoal/neutral-frost chrome and full-colour approved expressive content through semantic asset keys. Modal-first means the complete game background is uniformly blur/dim/desaturated and inert; the fixed platform banner dock remains mounted outside that game viewport. No visible accounts/login, telemetry, credentials, live Firebase, ad SDK or unreviewed asset downloads. Keep local presentation distinct from authority: clients display server/solo-engine phases and deadlines, never compute secret outcomes, choose timeout targets, advance multiplayer on a local clock or reveal another alignment. Use injected semantic media/ad/purchase ports; no direct SDK playback or billing calls from UI. Edit only ownership, use original fixtures, run scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check. DOM tests use jsdom, explicit afterEach(cleanup), Vitest and current Testing Library. Report results and contract changes; do not commit, push, open PRs, deploy or spend on providers. Implement a blocking glass Match End modal over the fully inactive City Board. Consume only an authoritative terminal winner/reason and final disclosure, render all approved roles and round timeline, then local badges/statistics from the achievement port. Provide Again plus Back to lobby (Solo returns to setup) and Exit game to Home. Do not infer victory from legacy5/5 or an incomplete board; canonical wins are Repair6/Sabotage6 or Disconnect/containment of The Null. Emit a post-match exit opportunity to monetization only after the result has been read and an explicit exit is chosen; never show/wait for interstitial inside reveal or block navigation if ads fail. Declare this presentation module readonly props locally from the documented fields and accept injected callbacks/asset lookups; do not import an unfinished server implementation. A035/A048 adapt canonical production DTOs and parsed intents into these props. The canonical producer contracts are A025 observeMatchV1/getLegalActionsV1 and A056 versioned recipient DTOs (A067 projects multiplayer views); public/private/legal fields must originate there, never raw hidden MatchStateV1. A004 owns exact I01–I06 option labels and all36 semantic icon keys.
acceptance: Only an authoritative terminal result enables full role reveal, with correct six-node/Null reason and retained round timeline.
Match End remains the sole game focus over uniform blur/dim and reserves the always-mounted free-banner viewport.
Again, multiplayer lobby, Solo setup and Home exits map exactly to the selected mode and explicit user intention.
Post-match ad opportunity occurs only after result reading and chosen exit; absent/failing ad handling cannot hold the player.
designSections: SCREEN-FLOW: 11. Match end / afterimage; RULES-SPEC-v1: 2. Win conditions
